changeset.li: New upstream version, the one of Debian Forky, with Debian's patches except the one that needs its package unicode-data
Packages as in Debian: gpg, gpg-agent, gpgconf, gnupg-utils, gnupg-l10n, scdaemon, gpg-wks-client and gpg-wks-server are new, gnupg only requires gpg, gpg-agent, gpgsm, dirmngr and gnupg-l10n
The transitional packages gnupg-agent and gpgv2 are gone
gpg-agent calls pinentry-curses unless it is configured otherwise
Upgrade to version from Debian Bullseye
Upgrade to latest version from Debian Buster.
